change.summary: Replace the c6 retained linear-attention rowchunk2 bridge with native rows=6 linear attention plus per-row c1 MoE only on linear-attention layers.
change.runtime_default: HIPENGINE_QWEN35_RETAINED_BATCH_DEFAULTS=1 now auto-selects per-row linear MoE for rows=6 when selected-c1 MoE is active and both linear-MoE and linear-rowchunk env overrides are blank.
change.scratch_fix: reserve_moe_c1_scratch(prefix=...) now applies the prefix to shared_out, moe_out, and shared_rotate_fuse_barrier so row-local c1 MoE scratch cannot alias batch MoE outputs.

local_generated_equality.reason_blocked: Diagnostic path uses per-row linear MoE and serial LM-head, so it is not a native-caware retained performance claim.

old_c6_bridge.description: full-attention rowchunk2, linear-attention rowchunk2, selected-c1 MoE, native/batch projection, serial LM-head

new_c6_repair.description: full-attention rowchunk2, native rows=6 linear attention, per-row c1 MoE on linear layers, native/batch projection, serial LM-head
